notes: This C++ TCK trace covers one derived-only attribute, its invalid base-class pairing, and a valid declaring-class control. It does not establish the full §8.25 exception matrix or conformance.

requirements.source_symbol: Change default order requires an available class attribute
requirements.statement: When changing a default order type, a class attribute shall be specified using a class handle for which the class attribute is available along with the class attribute’s handle.
